title: 2014 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Nani Roma (Monster Energy X-Raid Team) and Marc Coma (KTM Red Bull Rally Factory Team)
summary: The 2014 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 13 stage towns and bivouacs through Argentina, Chile. Winners — Cars: Nani Roma (Monster Energy X-Raid Team); Bikes: Marc Coma (KTM Red Bull Rally Factory Team); Quads: Ignacio Casale (Tamarugal XC Rally Team); Trucks: Andrey Karginov, / Andrey Mokeev, / Igor Devyatkin (Kamaz-Master).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
